'''dmaul69 Be vewwy vewwy quiet, were hunting jedi (HD)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[dmaul69]]
* '''Published:''' 30 January 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 HD dmaul69 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

Beatdowns and dueling basically

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Usually try and set up beatdowns with snipers, boba fett, dueling, maul strikes.

It has trouble sometimes with hidden base but with search and destroy, security precautions and mauls ship you can take care of it.

I usually put a few guys at one sight for the flip and wait for them to deploy and unload on them.

With the duels, sniper, maul strikes, sidious,choking, you should be able to elminate characters pretty easily and beat them down.
